stories.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
stories.explanation: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, offering improved professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower costs across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API. This is a significant update to their core AI models.

stories.title: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
stories.explanation: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform debuted with leading performance in MLPerf Training and Endpoints benchmarks, sweeping every MLPerf Training v6.1 benchmark and showing significant gains in agentic AI throughput per watt. This demonstrates strong performance for NVIDIA's new AI platform.

stories.title: Put Gemini to work for you
stories.explanation: Google updated Gemini with new 'Tasks' features, allowing it to handle complex tasks like scheduling appointments, managing bills, and shopping by connecting to Google Workspace. This expands Gemini's capabilities as an AI assistant.

stories.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
stories.explanation: NVIDIA announced new tools for AI agents, including Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU, and an expanded Vera CPU platform at SC26. This aims to accelerate scientific research with AI agents and new hardware.

stories.title: US moves to cut China’s remote access to AI chips
stories.explanation: The US is moving to cut China's remote access to AI chips by closing a loophole that allowed foreign rivals to rent access from data centers. This policy aims to prevent rivals from using advanced AI for military and intelligence activities, impacting global AI chip access.

stories.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
stories.explanation: Amazon will own nearly 15% and Google nearly 14% of Anthropic after its IPO, following the conversion of promissory notes into equity. This details the significant stakes major cloud providers hold in Anthropic.

stories.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
stories.explanation: Google is expanding access to Gemini Tasks, a feature that allows the AI assistant to perform actions like coordinating calls, logging into websites, and making purchases. This makes Gemini a more active personal assistant for a wider user base.

stories.title: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence
stories.explanation: Astra for Law, an OpenAI product, ranked first in a launch evaluation across 24 areas of law and is now available to ChatGPT Enterprise customers. This indicates a new specialized AI offering for the legal sector.

stories.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
stories.explanation: Model ML, a startup automating investment banking tasks with AI, raised $250 million in Series B funding at a $1.5 billion valuation. This funding will support its AI agents that automate financial modeling, presentations, and due diligence.

stories.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
stories.explanation: Microsoft Research introduced TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin for AI coding agents that learns from past sessions to reduce token costs and improve efficiency. This aims to make AI coding agents more cost-effective and efficient.
